w: Swamishri arrived in Gandhinagar at 8:20 p.m.

During Swamishri’s dinner in the evening, a volunteer guide at the Akshardham complex presented incidents of how visitors were impressed of their visit to Akshardham. At the end, the volunteer asked Swamishri, "What do you think is the fruit or result of visiting Akshardham?"
Swamishri, "By seeing it, the person takes a positive impression, and he attains Akshardham (heaven) and experiences peace and happiness in life."
The volunteer however added, "I think the greatest fruit or consequence of seeing Akshardham is that the visitor will understand and realize the greatness of Pramukh Swami Maharaj."

Swamishri,"They get impressed by the power and divinity of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. The murti of Bhagwan Swaminarayan in the monument is divine and miraculous and that is why everyone gets so impressed and develops faith for Swaminarayan."

The volunteer however persisted in emphasizing Swamishri’s greatness, "But it is you who has introduced the murti." Swamishri, "God is the root. We are all behind Him. If He is not there, then we are of no value."
During a personal meeting in the evening, Mr. Jim Karygiannis, M.P. Swamishri blessed him.

At 11.15 p.m., Swamishri visited the Radhakrishna Mandir for darshan. Swamishri performed arti and blessed the trustees. Thereafter, Swamishri visited the Bharatiya Mandir for darshan. After performing arti, Swamishri briefly addressed the congregation.
In the evening, after the Shikshapatri parayan by Pujya Viveksagar Swami, the Kishores enacted the drama on Joban Pagi's transformation.

At 10.30 a.m., Swamishri arrived at Galvada and after Thakorji's darshan performed pujan and arti of the murtis in the newly built Swaminarayan Mandir. Then Swamishri attended the satsang assembly, blessed the devotees and visited the farm sanctified by Shastriji Maharaj. Here Swamishri sprinkled the holy water from a well on his head and on all the sadhus and devotees. Then Swamishri went by the large banyan tree where Shastriji Maharaj had sat and delivered spiritual discourses. Swamishri held the hanging branches of the tree and gently rocked himself.

In the evening assembly in Amalner, an announcement was made about the naming of the street and chowk by the mandir as 'Pramukh Swami Road' and 'Swaminarayan Chowk'. The devotees honored Shri Harikrishna Maharaj.

From 3 January to 31 January the sadhus of Atladra Mandir sanctified the homes of 4,612 devotees with the murtis of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. The devotees worshipped the murti, offered food or an annakut and honoured Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. At 6.00 pm, the special evening assembly was packed with 23,000 devotees, all eager to honour Shri Harikrishna Maharaj in the presence of Swamishri. The seven little murtis of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj were adorned in palanquins. Then as they proceeded towards the main stage, youths danced with joy and devotion. The devotees became engaged in darshan of the grand, divine pageant. When the murtis were placed on the stage, Vedic peace mantras were chanted. Swamishri performed pujan of all the Thakorjis. Then in his blessings, Swamishri said, “You have all offered your services with joy and faith, so God will be happy upon you… When one realises the glory of God in one’s heart then one attains the opportunity to serve. To sacrifice and give everything is indeed a great thing. The fruit of this human birth is not to attain the objects of this world, but to have His darshan and serve Him…” Swamishri remained seated as 11,000 devotees filed pass to honour Shri Harikrishna Maharaj.
